descriptionChirho: General ability or capability to do something; the basic modal sense of having the power, capacity, or permission to perform an action.
To prevail or overcome against an opponent or adversary; to gain the upper hand in contest or struggle (Arabic غَلَبَ, Korean 이기다, Swahili -shinda, Hindi जीतना/प्रबल होना).
To endure, bear, or tolerate suffering, burden, or hardship (Arabic احْتَمَلَ, Korean 참다, Swahili -vumilia, Spanish soportar, Hindi सहना).
